international.title: Democrats capture at least 258 House seats in largest sweep since 1992
international.summary: Milestone reached Sunday, after Democrat Chuck Hubbard defeated Republican Virginia Foxx in North Carolina House Democrats have secured their best general election result in decades, winning at least 258 seats in a midterm election sweep unseen since 1992 that creates not only vast opportunities to govern but also intense pressure to deliver on campaign promises and priorities. Democrats have gained 44 House seats so far, four more than the 40 they picked up in Donald Trump’s first midterm in 2018. Continue reading...
